title: Helsinki Design Manual

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Distinguish the city’s physical character from its graphic identity so design decisions can connect both without confusing their roles.
strategic_value: Referencing Helsinki’s materials, greenery and urban history can ground contemporary expression in recognizable local experience.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture describes the city’s physical features, links to the urban design manual and explains its relationship to visual identity.
practical_value: Use the manual for urban materials and forms while using the visual guidelines for graphic expression.

content_islands.spec: Introduce furniture, greenery, buildings and materials as contributors to city experience.

content_islands.name: Related manual
content_islands.spec: Place the manual link before the explanation of the two complementary design levels.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text identifies the surrounding city as an inspiration for the visual identity and relates the two to stability and change.
reference_purposes.Application: It points readers to the manual for shapes, materials, vegetation, colors and history.
